verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page: a secure, pre-built page hosted by Airwallex that accepts multiple payment methods through one integration, with custom styling rules. The quickstart walks through an end-to-end payment using it, so developers can redirect customers without building their own payment UI. Billing adds a hosted checkout page, and redirect-flow guidance is published. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of conversion-optimization features on the hosted page itself (the conversion material covers the separate Multi-Currency Pricing API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted checkout.
